summary: Fail closed on unselected dsl fences in Markdown carriers

delivery.outcome: The Markdown carrier selector classifies every dsl fence and rejects unclassifiable ones instead of silently dropping normative-looking text.
nonGoals: No Policy DSL grammar, Policy IR or candidate GBNF change
No LLM boundary or decisionProtocol redesign of this manifest
No change to consuming repositories or their vendored checkers

architecture.decision: Classify each dsl fence in extract_markdown as placeholder illustration, Policy DSL header, independent DOCUMENT (second header or foreign SCHEMA), registered record kind (DECISION) or selectable fragment; raise POLICY-SYNTAX-001 for anything else and for fragments before the header.
interfaceChanges: validate-markdown rejects unclassified dsl fences and policy fragments before the DOCUMENT header
architecture.rollback: Revert the selector classification, fixtures, specification text and manifest bindings.

validation.evidence: POLICY-CONFORMANCE-PASS and POLICY-MARKDOWN-PASS for both valid carriers.
Exit 1 with POLICY-SYNTAX-001 at the DONE WHEN fence.
All tests pass except the pre-existing host-dependent test_compare_www_plans_accepts_live_www_when_present, which fails identically on the accepted base.
